summary: Today features significant legal developments, including a Karnataka High Court ruling and notable corporate earnings in the retail sector.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court calls for an integrated database of criminal cases to streamline judicial processes.
Saurav Ganguly has filed a lawsuit in Delhi High Court claiming rights over his iconic shirtless celebration in the movie Doosra.
Sapphire Foods India Limited reported a net loss of Rs 1.1 crore in Q2 FY27, down from a profit of Rs 14.2 crore.
Swiggy's Q2 loss narrowed to Rs 922 crore, while revenue increased by 36% year-on-year to Rs 1,200 crore.
True Palate aims for Rs 1,000 crore revenue and 50 outlets by 2030, planning a Rs 40 crore expansion.
